description: Engine §4.1 and §6: an unused descendant pattern does not split another erased completion.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution fewest #·zz
%rule text $w:w $e:e
%conditions $w ≅ #w, $e ≅ #·e
%rule w W
%rule probe $p:e
%conditions $p ≅ #(⋮ a)
%rule e a | b
%erased
%rule a A
%rule b A
%rule zz B B B
